{"answer":"Several methods use hierarchical structure to connect queries with relevant chunks. NavTree builds a balanced tree over chunks and navigates it with lexical and dense signals, returning leaf chunks rather than summaries [1]. SproutRAG organizes sentence chunks into progressively larger units and uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve at multiple granularities [3]. DTCRS adapts summary-tree construction to document structure and query semantics, using subquestions to guide clustering [2]. For a corpus-level map linking documents to themes through supporting text, EviMap organizes evidence phrases into a topic hierarchy and lets users find documents associated with topics [6].","grounded":true}
